description: Zonas wifi del departamento del Meta is a dataset listed in Colombian national open data portal (datos.gov.co), an open data portal (Socrata), published or maintained by Gobernación de Meta, Meta. Actualmente la Gobernación tiene 103 zonas wifi ubicados en los 29 municipios del Meta, por tal motivo este dato permite ver la ubicación de las Zonas wifi que se encuentran en los diferentes Municipios del Departamento. Coverage: Gobernación de Meta, Meta. The portal files it under the publisher Gobernación de Meta, Meta. Its tags are municipios, tic, zonas wifi, meta. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal files it under the category Ciencia, Tecnología e Innovación. The portal shows 2021-07-05 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datos-gov-co-portal.
